benefit: Russian comfrey (Bocking 14 cultivar) deep tap roots mine potassium, magnesium, and trace minerals from the subsoil. Chop-and-drop mulch around fruit trees three to five times per season returns 4 to 6 percent K and 2 to 3 percent N back to the tree zone.

members.title: Comfrey plug ring at fruit tree drip line
members.body: Plant 3 to 4 Bocking 14 comfrey crowns just outside the tree drip line. Chop with a sharp shovel to 4 inches when 12 to 18 inches tall, leave foliage as mulch.
